articles.title: Tastemade
categories: All articles with a promotional tone
Articles with a promotional tone from November 2023
sentences: ==Funding== In 2012, Tastemade raised $5.3 million in series A funding from Redpoint Ventures.
In 2013, the company announced $10 million in series B funding from Raine Ventures and Redpoint Ventures.

In December 2015, Tastemade secured a $40 million Series D funding round led by Goldman Sachs, with participation from existing investors Redpoint Ventures, Raine Ventures, Comcast Ventures, Liberty Media, Scripps Networks Interactive, and Tohokushinsha Film Corporation, bringing the total funding to $80 million.

In October 2018, Tastemade closed a $35 million Series E funding round led by Goldman Sachs Growth Equity along with new investors Amazon and Cool Japan Fund, with participation from existing investors including Redpoint Ventures, Raine Ventures, Comcast Ventures, and Liberty Media, bringing total funding to $115 million.
